item.text: **Correcting probe limit logic and adding degradation reporting**

{"code": "        """Allow a probe request in the half-open state if under the limit.

        BUG_42: only allow when probe_count < max_probes and report degradation when blocked.
        """
        from orgops.health import report_degradation
        if self.probe_count < self.max_probes:
            self.probe_count += 1
            return True
        report_degradation("circuit.half_open")
        return False
", "comments": "Corrected the probe limit check and report when the half-open window is exhausted."}
